caption_L1: This is a area plot called Number of drug-related deaths due to cocaine use in England and Wales from 1993 to 2019. A linear scale from 0 to 800 can be found on the y-axis, marked Number of deaths. Year is measured along a linear scale with a minimum of 1995 and a maximum of 2015 along the x-axis.
caption_L2L3: The number of drug related deaths due to cocaine in England and Wales rose steadily to over 200 per year from 1996 to 2008. This number decreased between 2008-2011 but then there was a dramatic increase after 2011, doubling to 400 in 2017 and then tripling to over 700 in 2020.
